action.objective: Commit the verified knight move Nf4, keeping material sound and completing development.
action.rationale: h3f4 is the only commit-ready move: verified with complete mate-in-one safety check (no mating reply, no forced mate), tactical refutation not_found, and exact score -23, the best of the broad search. Nf4 activates the knight to a strong central square, attacking d5 and d3, and prepares castling. The only concern Bxf4 is answered since the knight is defended by e3 pawn and the d6 bishop would be traded for the knight; material remains balanced. No analyses remain to certify an alternative, and commit_ready_moves has only h3f4.
